# Copilot — Grant Agent Lab

Eval harness is in-repo (`src/harness`). Enable MCP `grant-agent-harness` (`python3 -m src.harness mcp`).

1. `grant_harness_review_text` then `grant_harness_score_checklist` then `grant_harness_fill_intake`.
2. Never claim NIH ASSIST submit. Office of Research Aid only.
3. Do not invent budget dollars. Do not auto-check PI_CERTIFY.
4. Regression cases: `weak_aims_vague`, `good_aims_auditory`, `incomplete_package`, `complete_ora_packet`.
